design_rules.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. Cards should have internal padding of p-8 or p-12.
design_rules.surfaces: Cards should have a flat background (`bg-card`), 1px subtle border (`border-border`), and no drop-shadow. Hover states should include a slight lift (`-translate-y-1`) and a subtle gold inner glow or border color change.
design_rules.animations: Implement a star field animated background on the hero section. Use spinning Mandala SVG dividers between major sections. Implement draw/bloom animations for Yantra symbols. Use scroll-reveal animations using framer-motion. Text headings should have a gold shimmer effect (using background-clip and linear-gradient).
design_rules.header: Sticky nav (`z-50`) with glassmorphism or solid deep background (`bg-deep/90 backdrop-blur-xl`) with a 1px border at the bottom (`border-border`).
design_rules.footer: Generous padding (`py-24`). Include WhatsApp contact link and important navigation.
design_rules.buttons: Primary CTA should use gold (`bg-gold-light text-[#111009]`) with sharp or slightly rounded corners (`rounded-md`). Hover state should be slightly lighter gold.

layout.strategy: Single page application with 3-state UI (Public, Client, Admin). Use state management to toggle views without routing away.

components_to_use: shadcn/ui (Cards, Input, Form, Dialog, Dropdown, Table for Admin, Calendar for Date Picker, Tabs)

hero_mandala.description: Abstract luxury 3D glowing gold mandala, use in Hero section

yantra_bg.description: Subtle dark terracotta and gold sacred geometry yantra background, use for About or Services background

consultant_portrait.description: Elegant Indian female business consultant portrait, use in About section

spiritual_calm.description: Man sitting on rock surrounded by water, calm spiritual

testing.instructions: All interactive elements, buttons, links, form inputs, and tab triggers MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`, `data-testid="nav-login-link"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors strictly mapping to the provided hex codes. Add Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans to Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the entire UI as a Single Page App. Create a state toggle (e.g., in the Nav or a debug widget) to switch between 'public', 'client', and 'admin' views.
For the Hero section, use framer-motion to create an infinite slow rotation on the mandala SVG/image.
Implement the 'Gold Shimmer' text effect using standard CSS animations on background-position with linear-gradient background clip.
The 6 Services cards should use the Bento grid style.
Do NOT implement a separate routing system for Client/Admin. Conditionally render the 'Client Portal' or 'Admin Portal' sections over/below the main page content when logged in.
